limitations: One fresh original complete syringe as a static visual prop. Barrel, plunger, thumb pad, bilateral finger flanges, seal, hub and attached needle count as one assembly. No capacity, needle length, color, plunger-position or size variants counted.

No numbers, graduation marks, letters, labels or logos. Actual unlabeled 128px renders inspected for projecting plunger, finger flanges, cylindrical barrel and thin needle. Assistant visual judgment, not an audience test.

Own approximate overall length: 16.3 cm; barrel outside diameter about 12 mm, visible needle diameter about 0.8 mm. These are generic artistic dimensions, not clinical specifications or capacity measurements.

Barrel has a real modeled hollow wall with low-alpha material and a visible dark seal. Static seal/barrel, flange/collar, rod/pad and hub/needle contacts intentionally overlap. No moving plunger rig or working fluid pathway.

Needle is a closed static exterior with an oblique end. No lumen, medical sharpening specification, drug, dosing, administration instructions, sterility, safety or operational function implemented or claimed.

Original BOSS source is privately retained research, with unverified photographer/manufacturer. One-view hidden rear and internal geometry are generalized. No reference photograph or photo texture is supplied.
Three decreasing LODs in BLEND, GLB and FBX. Actual reimport renders checked. Transparency may require engine-specific settings; no Unity or runtime certification.
UVs are valid overlapping per-face planar projections, not a unique packed bake atlas. Plain materials require no external images.
